description: Implement a LEAN C# pairs trading strategy on top-10 pre-computed candidate pairs with z-score-based spread mean-reversion entry/exit and multi-leg portfolio management.
agent_prompt: Implement a LEAN C# algorithm in /workspace/src/PairsTrading.cs that loads the top-10 candidate pairs from /workspace/data/I05_candidate_pairs.json (paired symbols from the 20-symbol universe in /workspace/data/universe.json) and runs spread mean-reversion. Requirements: (1) parse the JSON pairs file; (2) subscribe to all unique symbols across the pairs; (3) per-pair: compute rolling 60-day mean and std of log(P_a / P_b), then current z-score; (4) entry: when |z| > 2.0 enter spread (long P_a / short P_b for negative z, opposite for positive z) with equal dollar legs; (5) exit: |z| < 0.5 (mean reversion complete) OR per-pair stop-loss at z = ±3.5; (6) cap simultaneous active pairs at 10, total leverage at 1.5x. Run via run_lean_backtest. Outputs at /workspace/output/: backtest_summary.json (total_return, sharpe, max_drawdown, n_pair_trades), per_pair_log.csv (one row per spread trade with pair_id, entry_ts, exit_ts, entry_z, exit_z, exit_reason, pnl), portfolio_exposure.csv (timestamp, n_active_pairs, gross_exposure, net_exposure).

required_capabilities: Load and parse pre-computed candidate pairs from JSON
Manage multiple simultaneous spread positions (up to 10 pairs × 2 legs)
Implement atomic spread entry/exit with per-pair stop-loss
Cap simultaneous active pairs and gross leverage
